lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five to six vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in a grid-like distribution along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the columns of high-luminance blobs, forming distinct rectangular nodes where the vertical and horizontal axes of the patterning intersect.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal section, defined by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae individuals (remoras) attached to the pectoral fin and the ventral-lateral flank region.
